title: Back to Basics Prep
subtitle: Foundational contracting cert (70% to pass)
description: A structured prep journey for the contracting Back to Basics test. Move through topic stages at your own pace — study the material, then test yourself.

stages.title: FAR System & Definitions
stages.description: Foundational concepts, the FAR System framework, key definitions and conventions.

stages.title: Improper Practices & Ethics
stages.description: Standards of conduct, gratuities, procurement integrity, conflicts of interest.

stages.title: Administrative Matters
stages.description: PIIDs, SAM registration, FPDS reporting, contract closeout, records retention.

stages.title: Procurement Methods
stages.description: Commercial products, simplified procedures, sealed bidding, contracting by negotiation.

stages.title: Cross-Cutting Topics
stages.description: Competition requirements, publicizing actions, source selection.
